title: Nike and the LEGO Group Take Basketball to Another Dimension With a New Space-Inspired Collection
summary: The Nike x LEGO® basketball collection combines sport, space and style in footwear and apparel that encourage young athletes to bring imaginative play and personal expression to every moment of their day.
body_markdown:
Nike and the LEGO Group are inviting kids to imagine basketball beyond the court with a new footwear and apparel collection that unites sport, space and personal style.


The Nike x LEGO® basketball collection channels the energy of the game into expressive footwear and apparel that bring a playful world of space, astronauts and imagination to life. Created for basketball-loving kids, the collection gives young athletes new ways to connect with the sport and their personal style without taking the game any less seriously.


Built on[the shared belief that play fuels creativity](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-lego-partnership-announcement) , the collection combines Nike’s longstanding focus on the athlete* with the LEGO Group’s unmistakable design language to help kids feel excited, confident and ready to[bring their own style to the game](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-football-lego-collection-invites-kids-to-play-on-instinct) .


**Nike x LEGO Style, Ready for Space**


At the center of the collection are two unexpected, playful expressions of Nike footwear that are both kid-right and ready to play, featuring recognizable LEGO details and patterns, available in sizes ranging from 10.5C to 7Y.


- The **Nike Air Force 1 Low LV8** reimagines an iconic Nike model through a space-exploration lens, featuring an upper that takes after the look of an astronaut’s spacesuit. Sketched stitch detailing adds a playful, constructed feel, while a LEGO space-inspired Swoosh and minifigure details bring the collaboration to life.
- Taking the collection deeper into the unknown, the **Nike S.T. Dynamite** sends Nike’s kid-focused basketball model to an ice planet. Color-shifting finishes and a glitter outsole create an icy, galactic look while bringing new visual energy to the silhouette.


**From the Tunnel Walk to the Court**


The apparel collection imagines basketball in another dimension, capturing the energy of an outer-space tunnel walk and carrying it into an otherworldly arena.


Taken together, the pieces represent the young explorer’s uniform. Basketball silhouettes and culture references meet space-inspired graphics, custom brick-built scenes and hidden character details, creating a collection that feels rooted in sport while leaving room for imagination, humor and discovery.


- A printed ripstop pant uses durable materials and space-themed graphics to match the material story from the Air Force 1.
- A full-zip fleece hoodie delivers everyday comfort while extending the collection’s space-meets-sport story. Details include special LEGO space and Nike Swoosh logos, a lenticular basketball minifigure patch that changes with movement, and a spaceship-style sleeve port with a custom Nike Rayguns minifigure.
- A graphic T-shirt combines a short-sleeve silhouette with the visual language of a basketball uniform, connecting young athletes with different worlds through space iconography and playful minifigure details.
- A Dri-FIT mesh basketball short serves as the collection’s true performance apparel piece, bringing a basketball-right construction to the lineup and providing a functional counterpoint to the fleece and ripstop styles.


The Nike x LEGO basketball collection will be available November 2 at[nike.com](https://www.nike.com/) and retail locations in select countries across Asia, the Pacific, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East and Africa before launching in North America on November 24.


** If you have a body, you are an athlete.*
